# Multicore Management

> Multicore Management is a UK back-office support service built exclusively for tradespeople. We answer calls, prepare quotes, send and chase invoices, manage emails and diaries and keep the admin side of a trade business running so the tradesperson can stay on the tools.

## What we do

- Call answering in your business name, message taking and job booking
- Quoting: we prepare and send quotes from the details you give us
- Invoicing: we raise invoices, send them and chase late payments
- Email and diary management: inbox kept clear, appointments organised
- Material ordering, CRM upkeep, payment tracking and customer updates
- Client dashboard so you can see what has been done at any time

## Who it is for

UK tradespeople of every kind: electricians, plumbers, gas engineers, builders, roofers, landscapers and HVAC engineers. We support sole traders through to firms with 10 or more on the books. Everything is done remotely so we cover the whole of the UK.

## Why Multicore rather than a general virtual assistant

We only work with trades. The team understands the difference between a first fix and a second fix, knows UK suppliers and can answer technical questions from customers. This is specialist trade admin, not generic VA work and definitely not a call centre. Every client gets a dedicated admin manager.

## Key facts

- UK based, serving the whole of the UK remotely
- Open Monday to Friday, 08:30 to 17:00
- No long contracts, flexible packages (Starter, Growth, Enterprise)
- Pricing is tailored to each business: https://www.multicoremanagement.co.uk/#pricing
- 16+ years of hands-on trade and construction experience behind the service
